codeReview.summary: The rerun fixes the first blocker from `tasks-redesign`: completed tasks now live in an in-screen collapsible section with a chevron toggle and count badge instead of a separate tab. However, the combined fixes still do not clear the 0.8-opacity blocker, because completed rows are dimmed twice: `app/tasks.tsx` wraps each completed row in `opacity: 0.8`, and `TaskRow` also applies `opacity: task.completed ? 0.8 : 1`, yielding an effective opacity of 0.64 rather than the required 0.8.

issues.description: Each completed row in the collapsible section is wrapped in `opacity: 0.8` here, but `src/components/cards/task-row.tsx:106` already dims completed cards to `0.8`. With both fixes landed together, completed cards render at roughly 0.64 opacity overall, so the original blocker requiring completed cards at 0.8 opacity is still not fully satisfied.
